exposure: Nuchal cord (no nuchal cord, any turns, 1 turn, 2 turns, 3 turns or above)
nuchal cord for 3 turns or above
cohort: 4,404 singleton term pregnancies which underwent spontaneous labour
finding: Only nuchal cord for three turns or more was associated with higher incidence of meconium-stained liquor, neonatal unit admission, suspected foetal distress during labour, and emergency caesarean section, but not with adverse Apgar scores or mortality.
mod_finding: Nuchal cord with three turns or more was associated with a higher incidence of emergency caesarean section.
